Design & checks

The upper Z mounting grid is a single solid 6 mm plate, replacing the 42 mm deep ladder. The mounting face and actuator positions are retained. The rear strut steps inward and bolts into two 5 mm M4 inserts in the plate.

Two small bottom flanges attach the front frame directly to the Z-support foot with M4×12 screws and 5 mm inserts. The fixed base and braced stand have large rounded cutouts. The Z actuator is blue-gray; the radial actuator is terracotta.

Reprint the Z support, front frame, rear strut and stand. The offset upper plate needs slicer support when printed on the lower support’s back. Frame windows and bottom flanges also need slicer review. All prints fit the H2S envelope.

The 264T / 12T internal drive is 22:1. CAD motion, mounting, print and service-explosion checks are provided; physical stiffness and probing accuracy need testing.
